heroSummary: Humble ISD starts the 2026–2027 school year on Wednesday, August 12, 2026. The last day of school is Friday, May 28, 2027, with early release. Spring Break is March 15–19, 2027.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2025–26
content: The first day moves from August 13 to August 12.
The October break moves from October 13–17 to October 12–16.
The February break moves from February 9–13 to February 8–12; its first two dates remain the district's conditional inclement-weather days.
Spring Break and the last day each move one day earlier, to March 15–19 and May 28.

customSections.content: A few details are easy to miss in the district calendar.

groups.label: Calendar notes
items: Humble ISD has scheduled weeklong October and February breaks since 2019–20.
February 8–9 are inclement-weather days inside February Break. They may become school days if the district needs to recover time lost to bad weather.
School starts on a Wednesday so district offices can help families complete registration on Monday and Tuesday and students begin with a shorter first week.
Spring Break coincides with Lone Star College, and first-semester final exams take place before Winter Break.
The approval notice confirms at least 75,600 instructional minutes and 187 teacher workdays; it does not publish a student instructional-day total.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Humble ISD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Humble ISD students start school Wednesday, August 12, 2026. The district chose a midweek opening to leave Monday and Tuesday available for registration help and give students a shorter first week.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Humble ISD February Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: February Break runs February 8–12, 2027. February 8–9 are designated inclement-weather days and may become school days if Humble ISD needs to recover time lost to bad weather.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Humble ISD students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return Wednesday, January 6, 2027. Winter Break ends January 1, and January 4–5 are staff workdays with no school for students.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Humble ISD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 15 through Friday, March 19, 2027. Students return Monday, March 22.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Humble ISD have late-arrival and early-release days?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The district publishes 15 MS/HS late-arrival Thursdays, Friday early releases for SECHS, MS/HS early releases on December 17 and May 27, and all-school early releases on December 18 and May 28.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Humble ISD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Friday, May 28, 2027. It is an early-release day for all students; check your school for its dismissal time.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Humble ISD publish a Spanish calendar for 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Humble ISD publishes an official Spanish calendar PDF, available in the Downloads section on this page.

sourceReviewSummary: Sources used: Humble ISD's current two-page calendar PDF, academic-calendar page, and calendar approval notice.
sourceReviewDetails: Checked the first and last days, break ranges, student holidays, grading markers, late-arrival dates, early-release dates, and school hours against Humble ISD's official calendar sources.
The Board approval notice is dated January 13, 2026; the current two-page PDF is separately marked “Approved 2/24/26.”
The approval notice confirms at least 75,600 instructional minutes and 187 teacher workdays; Humble ISD does not publish a student instructional-day total in these sources.
The PDF states that February 8–9 may become school days if time is lost to bad weather; the downloadable calendar keeps those dates tentative.
The ICS file is a one-time import and does not automatically reflect later Humble ISD changes.
